crossRefs.note: He said to them, “Is it well with him?” They said, “It is well. See, Rachel, his daughter, is coming with the sheep.”

crossRefs.note: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.”…

crossRefs.note: David left his baggage in the hand of the keeper of the baggage, and ran to the army, and came and greeted his brothers.

translations.web: When Uriah had come to him, David asked him how Joab did, and how the people fared, and how the war prospered.
translations.bsb: When Uriah came to him, David asked how Joab and the troops were doing and how the war was going.
translations.kjv: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded of him how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.
translations.asv: And when Uriah was come unto him, David asked of him how Joab did, and how the people fared, and how the war prospered.
